How Scores Work
VAR model — industry standard for points leagues
PROJ PTSESPN projected season total — uses your league's exact scoring rules
REPL PTSReplacement level: last startable player at that position across all 14 teams
VARValue Above Replacement = PROJ - REPL. How much better than a free substitute?
BASEVAR x scarcity multiplier x injury factor, scaled 0-100 across the full player pool
FITBASE + upgrade over weakest starter + balance bonus (<=10%) + need bonus (<=12%) — all capped

📚 FDB Model Methodology

Statcast Signals

xwOBA, Barrel%, Hard%, Exit Velocity, Sprint Speed — the underlying process metrics that predict future performance better than rate stats.

Regression Correction

BABIP regressed 60% toward .300 mean. FIP/xFIP over ERA removes fielding noise. Strips luck from historical performance.

Multi-Year Weighting

1yr: full weight. 2yr: 60/40. 3yr: 50/33/17. Recency-weighted projections handle breakouts and aging curves.

Monte Carlo Validation

1,000 head-to-head snake draft simulations. Gaussian noise (σ=22%) on actual points models realistic season variance.

💰This League's Scoring System

Understanding the exact point values is the foundation of every model decision. FDB prices each scoring category precisely — ESPN rankings do not.

CategoryPointsFDB Notes
Home Run (HR)+4Primary power driver
RBI+2Context-dependent — lineup slot matters
Run (R)+2OBP + lineup placement premium
Stolen Base (SB)+5Highest per-opportunity value
Total Base (per TB above 1)+1Doubles & triples carry implicit bonus
Strikeout (batter)−1🔑 Biggest market inefficiency — ESPN ignores this
Walk (BB)+1BB% as hidden scoring driver
Win (SP)+5Floor protection for SPs
Strikeout (pitcher)+1SwStr% is the leading indicator
Quality Start (QS)+3SIERA <3.80 → high QS probability
Save (SV)+5Closer role tracking critical
Hold (HD)+5🔑 Only 34 pts/season behind elite closer — massively undervalued
ERA (per run allowed)−1Driven by FIP/xFIP regression model
WHIP component−1GB% pitchers limit damage
Why K-rate is the #1 market inefficiency: A 30% K-rate hitter in 600 PA generates 180 Ks = −180 pts. A 15% K-rate hitter loses only 90 pts. That 90-pt gap equals ~15 HR or ~30 SB. ESPN ADP does not price this at all.
Hold value is massively underpriced: A 30-hold setup man projects ~456 pts vs an elite closer's ~490 pts — only a 34-pt gap. The optimal strategy: 1 elite closer + 2 high-hold setup men.

🔄The Data Pipeline — 5 Sources, 6 Phases

Every morning the model fetches fresh data from multiple sources, blends them by confidence weight, applies regression corrections, and outputs projections for every rostered and waiver-wire player.

1
ESPN Fantasy API — Live Roster & Scoring
Your live roster, opponent roster, waiver wire (500 players), current matchup scoring, standings, and ESPN's ADP rankings. Cached in SQLite for speed.
LiveRosterMatchupADPWaivers
2
FanGraphs via pybaseball — Advanced Rate Stats
Prior-season and current-season leaderboards. Hitters: wRC+, wOBA, ISO, BABIP, BB%, K%, Hard%, Barrel%, LD%/GB%/FB%. Pitchers: FIP, xFIP, SIERA, SwStr%, K/9, BB/9, K-BB%, HR/FB%, LOB%, GB%. Blended: 60% ESPN live + 40% Steamer/ZiPS consensus projection.
wRC+FIP/xFIPSIERASteamerZiPS
3
Baseball Savant — Statcast Layer
Exit velocity, launch angle, barrel rate, hard-hit rate, sprint speed, xwOBA, xBA, xSLG (hitters) and xERA, whiff rate, CSW%, GB rate (pitchers). Drives breakout/regression pre-classification: xwOBA − wOBA > .030 → BREAKOUT_CANDIDATE, ERA − xERA > 1.00 → SP BUY_LOW signal.
Breakout 🟢xwOBAxERASprint SpeedBarrel%
4
MLB Stats API — Schedule, Lineups & Player Ages
Today's full MLB schedule with probable starters, confirmed lineup statuses (confirmed / not_in_lineup / pending), player birth dates for aging curve badges, and two-start pitcher detection. A 2-start SP is worth ~1.75× a 1-start SP that week — the highest in-season leverage point.
Free APIScheduleLineups2-StartAge Badges
5
Regression Correction Engine — Strips the Luck
BABIP overperformers discounted up to −20% (regressed 60% toward .300 mean). xwOBA underperformers boosted up to +8%. LOB% and HR/FB% ERA normalization applied. IL severity detection: Tommy John → 0.15× factor, Long IL → 0.55×, Generic IL → 0.80×. These corrections directly adjust the projected point totals — not cosmetic labels.
BABIP CorrectionxwOBA BoostPark FactorsIL Severity

⚔️FDB Model vs ESPN Rankings — What's Different

🟢 FDB Model
✅Prices −1/K exactly — K-rate is the biggest hidden drag
✅+5/Hold modeled — setup men nearly as valuable as closers
✅FIP/xFIP over ERA — strips fielding noise from pitcher value
✅Statcast xwOBA/xERA — finds breakouts before market reacts
✅BABIP regression — avoids overpaying for lucky hitters
✅Park factor adjustments — Coors 1.16×, Globe Life 0.92×
✅2-start multiplier — highest in-season leverage point
✅Steamer+ZiPS consensus blend — outperforms any single system
✅Aging curve badges — flags 32+ speed players as regression risks
✅Live 2026 in-season blend — grows from 10% → 70% confidence
🟡 ESPN Default Rankings
❌K-rate not priced — treats 30% K same as 15% K hitter
❌Holds undervalued — closers overpriced vs true point gap
❌ERA-based — inflates pitchers who got lucky with LOB% or HR/FB%
❌No Statcast layer — misses breakout signals entirely
❌No BABIP correction — overpays for .370 BABIP flukes
❌No park factors — treats all home parks equally
❌Single-year focus — misses multi-year aging trends
❌Single projection system — higher variance, more busts
❌No age-curve modeling — holds aging stars at peak value
❌Static preseason ranks — doesn't blend live 2026 data
